plan.title: A reading plan's proof is a short voice recap in their own words, with a why and an easy alternative

context.text: finish Atomic Habits this month, then keep going with more books
Love that. Every night, or a few nights a week?

transcript.text:
Finishing Atomic Habits this month, then moving on to more books: I like that, Priya. Here's the plan:
• Goal: finish Atomic Habits this month, then keep going with more books
• Day 1 is tonight: read Atomic Habits in bed for 20 minutes
• Every night at 9:15 pm, 20 minutes
• Proof: a 1-minute voice note recapping what you read, in your own words. Saying it out loud helps it stick. If you can't do a voice note, a photo of the page you stopped on works too.

Each night shapes the next one. We'll check your pace against the finish line and adjust as we go. What do you think?
Priya, before we lock it in: are you committing to this plan, 20 minutes every night at 9:15 pm, starting today?
